prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end square studio portrait using the approved adult photo as the main subject. The clearly adult person stands confidently against a clean minimal background in soft neutral tones, wearing a black blazer over a simple light top and holding a large vertical poster in front of them. The poster features an artistic reinterpretation of the same approved adult face, stylized as a digital illustration, sketch, or painterly artwork, clearly recognizable as the same fictional creator identity. Use professional studio lighting with a soft approximately 5000K key light and subtle rim light to create gentle shadows and depth. Keep the expression calm and confident, the posture relaxed yet strong, the composition clean and balanced, the skin texture natural, and the poster edges crisp. Use a contemporary generic creator-branding vibe with no real name, logo, or public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure name, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, mismatched face, distorted poster edges, illegible copy
